description: Diff a repo's dependency manifests and lockfiles against a base (git ref or directory) and grade every added, removed, and changed dependency: install scripts, typosquat-shaped names, downgrades, prerelease jumps, widened ranges, and lockfile drift. Fully offline unless online is true, which adds npm registry checks (version age, publisher change, provenance, deprecation).

base.description: Git ref to diff against (for example HEAD~1 or a tag)

base_path.description: Directory holding the base manifest set to diff against

content.description: Also run content mode: fetch both versions' tarballs and diff the install-time surface statically, nothing installed or executed (default false)

online.description: Also run npm registry checks (default false; the base verdict never needs the network)

path.description: Local path of the repo or directory to check

name: guard_path
